question.text: A 'Contribution Agreement' in a Cat III AIF records:

answer.text: Terms on which an investor participates in the fund, including drawdown schedule

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.3 and 4.2.8, Contribution Agreement records an investor's participation terms including drawdowns. The Trap: Narrow scopes miss the complete document. Cross-Exam Context: Core AIF legal document. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Keep each investor's Contribution Agreement on file; they may carry side-letter rights.
